paragraphs: Hey, I’m **Fahim**. I’m a **Machine Learning Engineer** at **Masharah Advisory**, where I build pipelines that turn classical Islamic legal texts into structured digital knowledge. Before that, I spent over a year as a **Computer Vision Engineer** at **Quantigo AI**. There I validated and deployed detection models for real‑world use.

I also help businesses put AI to work. I build **AI agents and chatbots** that answer questions from their own documents. My other work covers **automation workflows**, **document processing and OCR systems** and **computer vision models**. I take each project from idea to a working solution and test its accuracy before handover. Clear milestones and proper documentation mean you always know what you’re getting.
